#  Feather Touch

**Turn your feathers into the ultimate non-lethal weapon!**

---

##  What Does It Do?

Tired of feathers collecting dust in your chest? Feather Touch gives them purpose! Now you can **attack any mob with a feather** and send them flying with satisfying knockback — no damage dealt, just pure aerial physics.

---

##  Features

- ** Attack with Feathers** — Right-click any mob while holding a feather to launch them backward
- ** Epic Knockback** — Mobs get launched with 0.4 horizontal + 0.2 vertical velocity (even Iron Golems!)
- ** Critical Hit System** — Jump and attack for dramatic crit particles and enhanced sound effects
- ** Immersive Audio** — Distinct sounds for normal attacks and critical strikes
- ** Works on All Mobs** — From creepers to villagers, everyone's fair game
- ** Non-Lethal Fun** — Perfect for pranks, mob sorting, or just messing around

---

##  How to Use

1. **Equip a feather** in your main hand
2. **Find a mob** you want to launch
3. **Jump and attack** for maximum effect (critical hit!)

---

##  Requirements

This mod requires the following to run:

| Mod | Required |
|-----|----------|
| [Fabric Loader](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-loader) | ✅ Yes |
| [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | ✅ Yes |
| [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) | ✅ Yes |

**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.11  
**Java Version:** 21

---

## 🔧For Modpack Creators

Feel free to include Feather Touch in your modpacks! No permission needed — just credit is appreciated. 💛
